criteria.criterion: One purchase records seller (existing supplier or typed private seller), date, optional receipt number, receipt photo or PDF pages, subtotal, seller tax as printed with its kind, delivery or other charges and notes.
criteria.evidence: src/domains/purchasing/purchases.ts recordPurchase writes the Purchase, every Appliance (own model, serial, price, purchaseId), PurchaseDocument pages and per-appliance acquisition-tax evidence in one transaction; the record-a-purchase screen (src/app/desk/purchases/new) takes the supplier or typed private seller, date, receipt number, uploads, delivery/other charges and notes; the supplier page lists purchases. tests/purchases-w14-w2-w15-integration.test.ts proves the linked 3-appliance receipt with exact totals; PDF/photo pages upload privately under purchases/.

criteria.criterion: Record a purchase replaces appliance intake: a grid row per appliance with type, manufacturer, model, serial, price, condition and color; a washer and dryer bought together are two rows.
criteria.evidence: Record a purchase replaces the old intake form and action (removed); a washer and dryer are two grid rows with their own type, manufacturer, model, serial, price, condition and color; real-Postgres test records a washer, dryer and unit on one receipt with distinct asset numbers.

criteria.criterion: Seller tax is split across the appliances by price with largest remainder, shown before saving, and subtotal plus tax plus other charges reconcile to the receipt to the cent.
criteria.evidence: purchase-math.ts splitSellerTax uses allocateAcrossLines (largest remainder) and reconcilePurchase proves prices + tax + other charges to the cent against optional typed receipt subtotal/total; the form shows the split before saving and the server recomputes it. tests/purchase-math-and-next-step.test.ts (26) and the real-DB test (101 cents over three unequal prices sums to 101) pass.

criteria.criterion: The tax question has no default; another state's tax is saved as later with a note and creates a CPA To do until IN-65 is answered.
criteria.evidence: taxAnswer has no default for the owner; YES_OTHER_STATE stores a state note, calculates nothing, and creates a CPA To do (integration test 'another state's tax'); validation tests refuse taxed answers without tax and tax on no-tax answers.

criteria.criterion: Each appliance links to its purchase, the seller page lists purchases, only OWNER and ADMIN can record or read them, a repeated save replays safely, and editing a tax answer after a return was filed produces the amendment To do.
criteria.evidence: Appliance.purchaseId links each machine; seller page lists purchases; recordPurchase/read pages are OWNER/ADMIN (requireRole + assertActiveTeamActor, STAFF/CUSTOMER refused for uploads and receipt reads, tests/private-photo-read-route.test.ts); operationKey+payloadHash replay and conflict tests plus a simultaneous double-submit test; updatePurchaseTaxAnswer after a filed return keeps filed rows and detectTaxFilingAmendments opens the amendment (real-DB test).

criteria.criterion: nextPurchaseTaxStep gives every answer exactly one next step: full tax done, partial or none use tax on the right return with its legal due date, tax-free for rent rent taxed, another state's tax a CPA To do until IN-65, later a To do in 3 days.
criteria.evidence: src/domains/tax/next-step.ts nextPurchaseTaxStep is the single pure decision; tests/purchase-math-and-next-step.test.ts has a table per answer: full seller tax done, use tax on the covering return with the calendar's legal due date, no filing account, filed with confirmation, tax-free for rent taxed, another state CPA To do, later To do.

criteria.criterion: The later To do turns high 7 days before the return covering the purchase closes, and the intake card, appliance page, purchase-order receiving and To do all show the same step.
criteria.evidence: Later To do is due 3 days after recording and severity turns high 7 days before the covering return's legal due date (tests on Nov 12 medium / Nov 13 high); record result card, purchase page, appliance Tax proof, PO receiving page and listAcquisitionTaxAttention all render the same step object.

criteria.criterion: Due dates come from the filing calendar, never hard-coded, and purchase-order receiving asks the same plain tax question.
criteria.evidence: Due dates come only from filing-calendar/stored TaxFilingPeriod via coveringUseTaxReturn; purchase-order receiving asks the same four-way question (receipt-tax.ts, receiving panel), creates PURCHASE_ORDER_LINE use-tax rows, and the owner can answer later; real-DB test covers admin-defers/owner-answers with the To do appearing and clearing.

criteria.criterion: Every appliance page shows a Tax proof panel with how it was acquired, the price and exactly one tax outcome.
criteria.evidence: src/app/desk/inventory/[id]/tax-proof-panel.tsx (owner/admin) shows how acquired, price paid, exactly one tax outcome from nextPurchaseTaxStep, seller tax or use tax with return and confirmation, and receipt links; getApplianceTaxProof tested for the filed-return case.

criteria.criterion: An audit pack for any date range lists every appliance and part bought with serial, seller, date, price, tax paid or use tax reported, the return and confirmation number and receipt links, as a printable page and a spreadsheet with stable columns, for OWNER and ADMIN only.
criteria.evidence: src/domains/tax/tax-proof.ts buildAuditPack + /desk/tax/audit-pack printable page + /desk/tax/audit-pack/export CSV with a stable 19-column order through the shared formula-safe toCsv; both gated to OWNER/ADMIN; real-DB test checks range filter, serial, price, tax, receipt link and totals; unit test locks column order and formula escaping.

criteria.criterion: Parts purchases join the purchase records and the audit pack, the retention setting starts at 7 years with an explanation, and a receipt that a filed return relies on is never deleted.
criteria.evidence: Parts deliveries join the pack line by line; recordRetentionYears defaults to 7 with an ⓘ explanation, owner-only compare-and-set audited editor (/desk/tax/record-retention); removePurchaseDocument refuses any purchase relied on by a filed return and the only page within the retention period, and PurchaseDocument.photo is ON DELETE RESTRICT (real-DB test attempts a direct photo delete).

planComparison: Actual production change (+2927/-387 across 39 files) exceeds the 2400-line estimate because parts receiving, the audit pack and the filed-return protections each needed complete domain, screen and test coverage; the three original subsections and their boundaries are unchanged.
newEngineering: Purchase/PurchaseDocument/PurchaseOrderReceiptTax persistence with additive migration; atomic idempotent record-purchase transaction with largest-remainder split; shared next-step with To do integration; purchase-order tax question with part use-tax rows; Tax proof panel; audit pack page and spreadsheet; retention setting and filed-return receipt protection.
relatedWorkDecision: W-14, W-2 and W-15 share one purchase/tax-evidence model; delivering them together avoided three CI cycles and rewiring the same screens and domain functions three times. W-3 and later items are not started.
